“RAIN READY CARAVAN: HANDA SA ULAN, HANDA SA BAHA”
The DOST-PAGASA, through the National Capital Region-PAGASA Regional Services Division (NCR-PRSD) in partnership with the Office of Civil Defense (OCD), will conduct an online Rainfall Warning System Caravan dubbed as “Rain Ready Caravan: Handa sa Ulan, Handa sa Baha” in Central Luzon (Region III), CALABARZON (Region IVA), and Metro Manila (National Capital Region).
The said caravan aims to (1) strengthen DRRM and LGU capacity on Rainfall Warnings and hazards of heavy rainfall, (2) promote clarity between Weather Advisories and Rainfall Warnings for disaster preparedness, (3) introduce and promote Impact-Based Forecasting, and (4) gather feedback from local early warning services for improvements.
We are enjoining all DRRM practitioners in various institutions, both public and private, as well as the Local Government Units (LGUs) in the three identified regions, to participate in the said caravan.
Let us all learn, interact, and collectively respond to the hazards of heavy rainfall! Please take a look at the post below for the schedule of activities.
